blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three water detention basins will be built inside the Luneta Park in Manila next year to help mitigate widespread flooding in the city, according to Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon. Dizon said that his agency and the National Parks Development Committee (NPDC) agreed to this plan during a meeting on Tuesday. The NPDC, an attached agency of the Department of Tourism, preserves, develops and manages Rizal Park and Paco Park in Manila. “We have agreed on the three detention basins inside the area of Luneta.
